title: Spok Supports All Leading Hospitals Named to U.S. News & World Report’s 2026-2027 Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll
summary: Distinguished pediatric hospitals rely on Spok to help connect care teams, coordinate critical information, and support exceptional patient care.
body_markdown:
*Distinguished pediatric hospitals rely on Spok to help connect care teams,*
*coordinate critical information, and support exceptional patient care.*


**Plano, Texas, (Sept. 22, 2026) –**[Spok, Inc.](http://www.spok.com/) , a wholly owned subsidiary of Spok Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: SPOK) and a global leader in healthcare communications, today reported that all of the 11 children’s hospitals named to the[2026-2027 U.S. News & World Report Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll](https://health.usnews.com/best-hospitals/pediatric-rankings) use Spok healthcare communication solutions to connect clinicians, streamline workflows, and deliver critical information. For over a decade, nearly every hospital named to the Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll has relied on Spok to support communication across complex care environments.


“We are proud to recognize these outstanding children’s hospitals and the clinicians and staff who provide exceptional care to children and their families,” said Vincent D. Kelly, chief executive officer of Spok Holdings, Inc. “Having every hospital honored on this year’s list as a Spok customer is particularly meaningful. Our communication solutions help their teams stay connected and coordinated, delivering secure and reliable communication when it matters most.”


U.S. News & World Report, the global authority in hospital rankings, has published its Best Children’s Hospitals list since 2007. The 2026-2027 edition marks the 20th annual Best Children’s Hospitals ranking. This year, 114 hospitals and thousands of pediatric specialists were surveyed across 11 specialties, including pediatric cancer, cardiology and heart surgery, orthopedics, and more. In total, 90 hospitals earned rankings in at least one specialty, with 11 earning top honors on the 2026–2027 Best Children’s Hospitals Honor Roll.


In August 2026, U.S. News & World Report shared its[2026-2027 Best Hospital Honor Roll ranking](https://www.spok.com/news-releases/spok-powered-hospitals-on-2026-2027-us-news-world-reports-best-hospitals-honor-roll/) . Eighteen of the 20 adult hospitals featured on the list also use Spok solutions. Consumers widely reference these rankings because they emphasize factors that directly impact patient care, including clinical outcomes, adherence to best practices, and the quality of hospital resources.
